title: UI for nerds
question: Three ways to lay out the new appearance window: its own window with a live preview inside, controls for every page (show/hide and reorder, size and density, colour and type, motion and effects), playful but tidy. Lock one, steer, or re-roll.

options.label: Before and after
options.thesis: The preview is split down the middle by a handle: your current look on one side, the edited look on the other, so every tweak is judged against what you had.
materials: a live miniature of the chosen page, split by a draggable handle
controls in a left column, grouped Layout · Size · Colour & type · Motion
Apply and Revert, with the count of changes
options.viewport: A page picker across the top (Everywhere, Home, Collection, Playlists, Downloads, Organizer, Visualizer, Player). Left: that page's controls. Right: the preview with its before/after handle. Footer: 4 changes · Revert · Apply.
options.risk: Changes wait for Apply instead of landing live; the split halves the preview's width.

raised.raise: Drag the handle to wipe between before and after; double-click it to flip sides.
The change count reads like a diff: '+3 −1 tweaks', with a Reset Everything escape hatch.

options.label: Click the thing you want to change
options.thesis: The preview is the menu: hover any part of the miniature page and it outlines; click it and the inspector beside it shows that element's controls.
materials: a large live preview that fills most of the window
a slim inspector on the right for the selected element
options.viewport: Page picker on top; a big live preview; on the right an inspector headed with the selected element ('Recommended for today · shelf') and its controls; a breadcrumb back to the whole page.
options.risk: Settings without a visible element (animation timing, the launch fade) need a separate 'Page' inspector; discovering what's clickable takes a moment.

raised.raise: Click a shelf, a badge or the player bar and its knobs appear; Escape walks back up to the page.

options.label: Pages, knobs, preview
options.thesis: Three columns read left to right: which page, its knobs, and the live result, so nothing is hidden and every change lands instantly.
materials: a page list with small icons
a live preview that scrolls with the knob you're touching
options.viewport: Left rail: Everywhere, Home, Collection, Playlists, Downloads, Organizer, Visualizer, Player bar, Menu bar. Middle: grouped controls. Right: the live preview of that page.
options.risk: Three columns get tight at small window sizes; the preview is the narrowest of the three.

raised.raise: Each slider shows its exact value (170 pt, 6 columns) beside a reset dot.
